documents.title: Acme Corporation Company Overview
expected_facts: Acme has 120 employees across six departments.
Acme has four service lines: Atlas, Beacon, Harbor, and advisory services.
Maya Chen is CEO; Elena Ortiz is CFO.

documents.title: Engineering Department Charter
expected_facts: Engineering has 38 employees.
Priya Shah owns Engineering; Theo Park owns Atlas technical design.
Engineering owns application code, not production identity administration.

documents.title: IT Operations Service Ownership
expected_facts: IT Operations has 12 employees and is led by Jordan Blake.
Morgan Reed is the incident commander primary; Imani Brooks is backup.
IT Operations owns SSO, backups, production access, and incident coordination.

documents.title: Finance and Procurement Operating Model
expected_facts: Finance and Procurement has 14 employees.
Ravi Desai leads the Procurement team; Elena Ortiz is CFO.
Software Budget is cost center CC-410.

documents.title: Customer and People Services Directory
expected_facts: Customer Success has 24 employees; Sales and Marketing has 20; People Operations has 12.
Samira Cole leads Customer Success; Avery Stone leads Sales and Marketing; Nora Ellis leads People Operations.
BridgeDesk is the internal request system; ClientDesk handles customer support.

documents.title: Priya Shah Leadership Profile
expected_facts: Priya Shah is Head of Engineering and Cedar executive sponsor.
Priya approves engineering priorities but does not approve vendor payments.

documents.title: Morgan Reed Operations Profile
expected_facts: Morgan Reed is SRE lead and primary incident commander.
Imani Brooks backs up Morgan for incident coordination.
Morgan owns restore-test evidence, not customer-facing messaging.

documents.title: Ravi Desai Procurement Profile
expected_facts: Ravi Desai leads Procurement within Finance and Procurement.
Ravi reviews vendor terms and issues purchase orders after required approvals.

documents.title: Samira Cole Customer Success Profile
expected_facts: Samira Cole leads Customer Success and sponsors Compass.
Samira owns customer incident communications and onboarding acceptance.

documents.title: Atlas Delivery Team and RACI
expected_facts: Theo Park is Atlas technical lead; Priya Shah is Cedar sponsor.
Cedar release readiness needs both Engineering and IT Operations review.
Imani Brooks is responsible for Atlas access configuration.

documents.title: Procurement Policy v2.1
expected_facts: Effective August 1, 2026, software purchases over $5,000 require the full review sequence.
CFO approval is additionally required above $20,000.
Use annual committed cost; do not split orders to avoid thresholds.

documents.title: Finance Approval Matrix 2026
expected_facts: $5,000 exactly follows the lower band; $20,000 exactly does not need the additional CFO approval.
$5,000.01 through $20,000 requires manager, Finance, IT Operations, and Procurement review.
No named CFO delegate is established by this matrix.

documents.title: Production Access Procedure
expected_facts: Production access requires manager approval, IT Operations approval, SSO, and MFA.
Temporary elevated production access expires after four hours.
Production access reviews occur monthly.

documents.title: Data Retention Standard v2
expected_facts: Application audit events are retained 365 days.
Support attachments are retained 90 days after case closure.
Operational backups are retained 30 days.

documents.title: Release and Rollback Procedure
expected_facts: Routine production releases occur Tuesdays or Thursdays from 18:00 to 20:00 UTC.
A release needs Engineering and IT Operations sign-off.
Rollback starts if error rate exceeds 2% for five consecutive minutes.

documents.title: Customer Support Severity and Response
expected_facts: P1 initial response target is 15 minutes, with updates every 30 minutes.
P2 initial response target is four business hours.
Response targets are not resolution guarantees.

documents.title: Hybrid Work and Travel Expenses
expected_facts: Travel reimbursement claims are due within 30 days of trip completion.
Meals are capped at $65 per person per travel day.
Travel requires manager approval before booking.

documents.title: Procurement Policy v1.4 Archived
expected_facts: Before August 1, the full-review threshold was above $2,500.
This document was superseded by ACME-011 effective August 1, 2026.

documents.title: Project Cedar Charter
expected_facts: Cedar improves Atlas approval workflows.
Cedar has a $48,000 approved project envelope.
Theo Park leads delivery; Priya Shah sponsors Cedar.

documents.title: Project Aurora Reporting Plan
expected_facts: Aurora adds regional reporting to Beacon.
Aurora pilot target is October 6, 2026, not an approved launch date.
Regional data residency and retention validation remain open gates.

documents.title: Project Ledger Vendor Cleanup Plan
expected_facts: Ledger cleans 240 vendor records, with 36 possible duplicate pairs.
Ledger uses a $12,000 project envelope.
Vendor records are merged only after Finance review.

documents.title: Project Compass Onboarding Plan
expected_facts: Compass standardizes customer onboarding and has an $8,000 envelope.
Pinecrest Services is the Compass pilot customer.
Compass targets handoff within ten business days after prerequisites are complete.

documents.title: Cedar Status September 4
expected_facts: Cedar current forecast is September 22, 2026.
Two release gates remain: retry regression and rollback-drill sign-off.
Cedar has $29,600 committed against its $48,000 envelope.

documents.title: Cedar Status August 21 Archived Snapshot
expected_facts: The August 21 Cedar snapshot reported green and a September 15 target.
ACME-023 supersedes this snapshot for current status.

documents.title: Access Cleanup Closure Report
expected_facts: Access Cleanup closed July 31, 2026.
It removed 18 stale test accounts and corrected seven ownership records.
No production customer accounts were deleted.

documents.title: Cedar Steering September 3
expected_facts: Priya approved a September 22 Cedar forecast.
Theo owns retry regression; Morgan owns rollback-drill sign-off.
The steering meeting did not waive release gates.

documents.title: Aurora Discovery Workshop
expected_facts: Aurora European hosting region remains undecided.
Leo must prepare a region trade-off review; Jordan owns operational review.

documents.title: Procurement Office Hours Threshold Notes
expected_facts: These unapproved notes incorrectly say CFO approval begins above $10,000.
Current controlled policy and matrix set additional CFO approval above $20,000.

documents.title: Finance Budget Review August 12
expected_facts: The four project envelopes total $100,000.
Nimbus has a separate $24,000 annual renewal ceiling.
Budget allocation does not replace purchase approval.

documents.title: Compass Pilot Kickoff
expected_facts: Pinecrest Services is the Compass pilot.
Its prerequisite checklist was complete August 24.
Scope includes one Atlas workflow and one Harbor integration.

documents.title: Incident Follow-up August 13
expected_facts: INC-2026-02 retry remediation requires a tenant-scoped idempotency key.
A replay test must prove one notification for repeated delivery of the same event.

documents.title: Security Retention Review August 29
expected_facts: The 365-day controlled audit retention standard governs Beacon.
Leo must reconcile Beacon documentation and validate implementation before Aurora pilot.

documents.title: Weekly Operations Review September 8
expected_facts: Ledger has reviewed 20 of 36 candidate duplicate pairs, leaving 16 unreviewed.
Fourteen pairs were approved for merge and six rejected.
No new P1 incident was reported at the September 8 review.

documents.title: ADR-001 Tenant-scoped Idempotent Delivery
expected_facts: Atlas uses tenant ID plus external event ID as the idempotency key.
Delivery remains at least once; deduplication does not make the transport exactly once.

documents.title: ADR-002 Central Identity and Application Roles
expected_facts: Acme uses central SSO with MFA for production access.
Application roles and infrastructure roles are separate.
Production elevation is limited to four hours under ACME-013.

documents.title: ADR-003 Backward-compatible Database Changes
expected_facts: Use expand-and-contract migrations for customer-facing services.
Destructive cleanup is deferred until the rollback window is closed.

documents.title: ADR-004 Harbor Connector Retry Contract
expected_facts: Harbor makes at most five delivery attempts total.
Retry delays after failures are 1, 2, 4, and 8 minutes.
After the fifth failed attempt the event enters the dead-letter queue.

documents.title: ADR-005 Beacon Regional Storage Decision Pending
expected_facts: ADR-005 is proposed, not accepted.
No European hosting region or cross-region recovery target has been selected.

documents.title: INC-2026-01 Atlas Login Outage
expected_facts: Atlas login outage lasted 42 minutes on July 9, 2026.
An expired SSO signing certificate caused the outage.
Existing sessions were unaffected; new logins failed.

documents.title: INC-2026-02 Duplicate Approval Notifications
expected_facts: A retry defect produced 27 duplicate notifications across nine Atlas workspaces.
Approval records were not duplicated.
Tenant-scoped idempotency is the corrective design.

documents.title: INC-2026-03 Harbor Connector Backlog
expected_facts: Harbor backlog peaked at 640 events after a vendor rate-limit change.
No events were lost in reconciliation.
Operators replayed the dead-letter queue after correcting rate limits.

documents.title: INC-2026-04 Restore Drill Retrospective
expected_facts: The restore drill took 95 minutes against a 60-minute target.
A stale credential reference delayed recovery.
The drill used synthetic data and caused no customer outage.

documents.title: Atlas Workflow Automation Service Guide
expected_facts: Atlas automates approval routing and audit history.
Atlas supports sequential approvals; customer-defined scripting is out of scope.
Cedar is an internal improvement project for Atlas.

documents.title: Beacon Administration Guide Draft
expected_facts: This draft incorrectly specifies 180-day audit retention.
The approved retention standard requires 365 days.
Beacon provides aggregate operational reporting.

documents.title: Harbor Managed Integration Reference
expected_facts: Harbor uses correlation IDs for support and a dead-letter queue for exhausted retries.
Five total attempts include the initial attempt.
The standard connector scope excludes custom payroll integrations.

documents.title: Advisory Services Statement of Work Template
expected_facts: Advisory engagements require a signed scope and explicit acceptance criteria.
The example engagement has discovery, design, and handoff milestones.
The template is not an executed customer contract or price list.

documents.title: New Employee First Week Checklist
expected_facts: Managers request access through BridgeDesk before employee onboarding.
Production access requires separate approval and MFA.
Day-five review checks access ownership and training completion.

documents.title: Support Analyst Citation and Handoff Exercise
expected_facts: Analysts must distinguish current policy from archived or draft evidence.
Unsupported questions should be escalated or clarified rather than guessed.

documents.title: Nimbus Compute Renewal Assessment
expected_facts: Nimbus Compute renewal quote is $22,800 annually against a $24,000 ceiling.
The renewal is not yet signed.
The $22,800 commitment requires CFO approval under the current matrix.

documents.title: September Project Budget Register
expected_facts: Project envelopes total $100,000; commitments total $50,000; uncommitted balance totals $50,000.
Cedar has $18,400 uncommitted; Aurora $22,400; Ledger $5,800; Compass $3,400.
Nimbus renewal is excluded from the project totals.
